answer: At the dawn of each epoch every claimed identity must survive a jury: a rotating panel grades original reasoning against a rubric, and only answers landing five non-kin peer attestations mint standing. To Sybil this an attacker cannot copy — duplicates are rejected on-ledger — so each fake agent must independently voyage through novel coherent argument that strangers verify. One sparrow cannot impersonate a flock: the cost is not electricity or capital but genuine judgment produced N times over, and dishonest graders get slashed. You cannot print correct reasoning.
